claim.candidate: FlowLab's full-revolution five-block O-grid product path numerically verifies steady incompressible laminar flow in one straight constant-diameter circular pipe against the Hagen-Poiseuille solution.
claim.boundaryCondition: discrete-flux-normalized fully-developed parabolic velocity inlet, zero-kinematic-pressure outlet, and no-slip wall

refinementInterpretation.uniformLogicalRefinement: Every axial, annular-radial, circumferential, and core-side count doubles.
refinementInterpretation.geometryTreatment: Circumferential wall faceting refines with the solution mesh. Observed order and GCI therefore quantify the combined solution-discretization and wall-geometry-realization sequence, not isolated solution discretization.

observationOperators.pressureDrop: Latest FlowLab-normalized OpenFOAM patchAverage(p) on inlet minus outlet, multiplied by densityKgPerM3 because p is kinematic pressure.
observationOperators.flowRate: Latest absolute inlet and outlet surface sums of phi from FlowLab-normalized patch metrics; the reported flow is their arithmetic mean.
observationOperators.velocityProfile: At the solver-VTK axial cell-centroid plane nearest x=L/2, compare cell-centred Ux to 2*Umean*(1-(y^2+z^2)/R^2). Relative L2 is the unweighted cell-centroid RMS error divided by the analytic cell-centroid RMS. Relative Linf is max absolute error divided by analytic centerline velocity. Transverse ratio is RMS(sqrt(Uy^2+Uz^2))/RMS(abs(Ux)).
observationOperators.meshExtent: Solver-produced VTK point bounds in x, y, and z.
observationOperators.qoiTailStability: Use the last 100 common positive-time samples, written every SIMPLE iteration, from inlet and outlet patchAverage(p) and sum(phi). Pressure stability is (max(deltaP)-min(deltaP))/abs(mean(deltaP)); flow stability is the same relative span applied to the arithmetic mean of absolute inlet and outlet flow. Require consecutive samples.
observationOperators.residualsAndContinuity: Retained OpenFOAM solve-log final residual and global continuity tails are reported as solver-health diagnostics, not v2 pass/fail gates. Near-zero transverse-component residual ratios and worst-sample continuity spikes do not override stable pressure, flow, conservation, and profile quantities.
observationOperators.solverCompletion: Require a zero exit code, an End marker without fatal or non-finite markers, and either a SIMPLE convergence declaration or the exact declared 2000-iteration budget.
observationOperators.observedOrderAndGci: Three-grid Richardson extrapolation on pressure drop using coarse-to-fine characteristic cell size, uniform r=2, and safety factor 1.25. Report unqualified with the exact reason when the sequence is non-monotone, degenerate, or otherwise mathematically invalid.

solverGateRationale.maximumPressureDropRelativeSpan: 0.05 percent is one thirtieth of the 1.5 percent maximum fine-grid GCI, keeping iterative variation materially below the discretization claim.
solverGateRationale.maximumMeasuredFlowRateRelativeSpan: 0.0025 percent is one quarter of the existing 0.01 percent conservation and target-flow gates.
solverGateRationale.maximumRelativeMassFlowImbalance: Unchanged from v1 and independently checked both over the QoI tail and at the retained final state.
solverGateRationale.solverControls: Physics, boundary conditions, discretization, residualControl values, relaxation, and the 2000-iteration budget are unchanged from v1; v2 changes the prospectively frozen decision operator and QoI sampling only.
